moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-range-soft-wave-reveal, written here): AE Range Selector, shape Ramp Up, ramp width 30 % of the line: the ramp sweeps the line linearly over 1.8 s (0.3–2.1 s); each char's amount v = smoothstep of its place in the ramp: opacity v, y (1 − v) × 0.35 em. Web equivalent: per char y 0.35 em → 0 plus fade, 0.65 s sine.inOut, starts spread over 1.2 s (≈25 ms each). Loop exit: fade 2.85–3.15 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: sweep: thời gian quét cả dòng (1.8 s) · width: độ rộng dải mềm (30 %) · y: quãng nổi (0.35 em). Like After Effects' Range Selector with a Ramp Up shape: each letter's amount is a smoothstep of its place in the moving ramp.
